noveltyJustification: All 12 findings are new: the 13-row parity table had no prior packet record, and each row names a Vibe mechanism (declarative plugins, strict hooks, closed slash-command set, TOML agents, Agent Skills metadata, run_typescript) not previously documented here.
keyQuestions: For each OpenCode surface this repository uses (plugins, spec gate, dispatch preflight hooks, session-relaunch loop, goal and context bridges, slash commands, custom agents, skills, MCP and Code Mode, permissions, self-invocation guard), does Vibe have an equivalent, a partial one or none, and what porting would it take?
answeredQuestions: For each OpenCode surface this repository uses (plugins, spec gate, dispatch preflight hooks, session-relaunch loop, goal and context bridges, slash commands, custom agents, skills, MCP and Code Mode, permissions, self-invocation guard), does Vibe have an equivalent, a partial one or none, and what porting would it take?
ruledOut: Treating Vibe plugins as an OpenCode plugin port target

graphEvents.label: Plugins are declarative bundles not event handlers
Strict pre_tool hooks can express the spec gate
Dispatch preflight maps to pre_tool and pre_agent hooks
Session relaunch becomes an outer driver
Slash commands are ten builtins plus skills
Skills use the Agent Skills frontmatter
MCP and Code Mode both have equivalents
Permissions are per-tool plus safety levels
